card.name: Last digit of years in URLs and dates
card.fires_on: The final digit of a four-digit year (like 2011 or 2000) being written out, most strongly inside web addresses with date paths, and also in citation dates and file names.

modes.label: Years in URLs
modes.description: Last digit of a year in a news-site address path before the month and day.

modes.label: Years in citations and file names
modes.description: Last digit of a year in a reference, date stamp or file name.

card.writes: It promotes season and part-of-year words and suppresses daily and weekday words, so it adds a time-of-year flavor.
card.plain: It fires on the last digit of a year, especially in web links and citations.
